name: Steffensen Cannon Scholarship (undergraduate)
eligibility: Full-time University of Utah undergraduates in a College of Humanities major, in good academic standing. Direct descendants of Ellen Christina Steffensen Cannon may be in any undergraduate program.
firstStep: You cannot apply on your own: the college has to endorse you. Contact your department coordinator well before the deadline.
note: A large award that runs by college endorsement. The College of Humanities lists the deadline as December 16, 2026 at 5 p.m. Mountain time.
caveat: The university's scholarship portal still showed last year's dates when we checked. Confirm the deadline with your department.

name: Tanner Humanities Center Graduate Student Fellowship
award: A research fellowship with dedicated office space at the center. The page does not state a dollar amount.
eligibility: Humanities graduate students at the University of Utah.
firstStep: Read the center's call for applications on its fellowships page.
note: An internal fellowship meant to speed up graduate students' research.
caveat: The center's page gives the deadline as December 1 without a year.

name: College of Humanities Scholarships (2027–28)
award: Many awards, most between $1,000 and $2,000. One application is considered for up to 250 scholarships.
eligibility: University of Utah undergraduates in the College of Humanities. Each award has its own criteria, such as financial need, merit or being a first-generation student.
firstStep: The application was listed as opening soon when we checked. Watch the college's page for the Liberal Arts and Sciences Scholarship Application link.
note: One application routes you to most College of Humanities scholarships for the 2027–28 year.

name: Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program (UROP)
timing: Summer 2027 applications are due in early March 2027. The office's page lists the date as Friday, March 6, which does not match the 2027 calendar, so confirm it there.
award: $1,200 stipend for 120 hours of research or creative work in a semester
eligibility: Degree-seeking University of Utah undergraduates who are eligible for university employment and have a faculty mentor.
firstStep: You need a faculty mentor before you can apply. Ask a professor whose work interests you now.
note: Paid time to do research or a creative project with a professor. The spring 2027 round closed October 30, 2026.

name: Seven Canyons Review
timing: Submission dates were not posted on the English department's page when we checked.
award: Publication in the university's undergraduate literary and art magazine
eligibility: Undergraduate students at the University of Utah and beyond.
firstStep: Follow the magazine's own site, linked from the department page, for its next submission window.
note: Publishes creative writing, art and photography by undergraduates.

name: Undergraduate Journal of Contemporary Issues & Media
timing: The last call closed September 1, 2026. The next call had not been posted when we checked.
award: Publication in a journal from the Department of Writing & Rhetoric Studies
eligibility: All undergraduates in any field, at any college or university.
firstStep: Drafts are welcome, so a class essay, zine, podcast or photo project you already have may be a fit.
note: Takes essays, short fiction, poetry, zines, podcasts, music, art, film and photography.

name: Utah Original Writing Competition
timing: The 2027 submission window had not been announced when we checked.
award: Prize money for first and second place. In 2025 the prizes ranged from $250 to $1,500, depending on the category.
firstStep: Pick a category now: novel, creative nonfiction book, short story collection, young adult book, short poetry, short story or creative nonfiction essay.
note: A statewide writing competition in seven categories. The official page says there is no entry fee.

name: Utah Conference on Undergraduate Research (UCUR)
timing: UCUR 2027 is February 26, 2027 at Utah State University in Logan. Applications to present have closed. The next call is expected in fall 2027.
award: A chance to present research or creative work as a poster, exhibit, talk or performance
firstStep: If you were accepted for 2027, the Office of Undergraduate Research says accepted University of Utah undergraduates are eligible to have their registration fee covered.
note: A one-day statewide conference where undergraduates share research and creative scholarship.

name: Utah Artist Fellowship
eligibility: People enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree in the arts, or in a field related to their art form, are not eligible.
note: A state fellowship that recognizes the careers of Utah artists.

name: Individual Artist Advancement Grant
eligibility: People currently pursuing an artistic academic degree are not eligible. Applicants must also be 21 or older.
note: A state grant intended for professional artists.
